title: Grateful Dead Live at Universal Amphitheatre on 1973-06-30

ai_review.summary: Excellent matrix mix captures a tight June 30 1973 set with standout Dark Star, Playing in the Band and vibrant vocals.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as a superb matrix blend of soundboard clarity and audience ambience, delivering balanced instruments, deep bass and crisp drums. The show itself is described as tight and energetic, highlighted by a sweet Dark Star jam, an outstanding Playing in the Band, and powerful vocal performances from Jerry and Bob. Overall the performance and mix are consistently rated highly by reviewers.

ai_rating.rationale: All eight reviews are 4–5 stars, uniformly praising both the musical performance and the matrix/soundboard recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Balanced matrix mix with clear instrument separation, pleasant crowd presence, deep bass, crisp drums, and a warm overall tone; reviewers note the sound is not overly crisp but very enjoyable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set described as well‑played with strong transitions (e.g., Playing in the Band into Dark Star), second set a bit shorter but still tight; overall flow praised.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Great vocal performance noted on Black Peter and throughout; wah‑wah peaks add color to his guitar work.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass described as deep and solid for a ’73 recording, providing a strong foundation.
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocals blend nicely with Jerry; rhythm guitar praised for firework‑like playing.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith’s Rhodes piano (misidentified by one reviewer as Moog) adds sweet texture; experimental touches appreciated.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill's drumming described as crisp and tight, driving the band's energy.
